why: One workflow runs the whole cycle and stops at the first gate it can't pass. About 20–25 agents.

The attach/resize hooks also set tmux's global `default-size` to your terminal's size, so new windows are created at the right size and never resize. Less code, no extra hooks. Cost: the fleet now owns `default-size` (unset in your conf today), and after you detach it stays at your last size.
